title: Aegis Sentinel verdict record
description: One population-scoped control verdict with its full audit trail. Conventions forked from GRCEngClub finding.schema.json v1.0.0 (knowledge/01_corpus/05_prior_art/Aegis_Prior_Art_GRCEngClub_Toolkit.md §3.1): const-pinned schema_version, closed objects, conditional requirements, the source/source_version/run_id/collected_at reproducibility tuple, severity independent of status. Deltas per docs/EVALUATION.md §2: record_hash + chain_prev, population_id/population_count/completeness_ref, spec_id + spec_hash, test_function_version, ratification_ref, and unknown_cause as the required companion of UNKNOWN. Verdict vocabulary and UNKNOWN why-codes follow the ratified rulings docs/DECISIONS.md D-V1 and D-U1 (PRD-v3 §2). skipped is deliberately absent: a population-testing system has no skip state that is not either EXCLUDED or a completeness failure. Hand-authored for the first milestone; superseded by the pydantic-generated schemas when SCH01 lands (D-P1).

schema_version.description: const-pinned semver; consumers pin a major version

control_id.description: Control identifier from the testing library, e.g. CM-03

claim_id.description: The Claim this verdict was evaluated against (src/aegis_sentinel/schema/models.py Claim.id)

assertion_id.description: The claim's Assertion this verdict evaluates (Assertion.id), of the type this record's evaluator tests

status.description: The five ratified verdict states (docs/DECISIONS.md D-V1, PRD-v3 §2): EXCLUDED is the former NOT_APPLICABLE and keeps its ratification_ref requirement; EXCEPTION is a dispositioned legitimate exception and requires disposition_ref

unknown_cause.description: Required companion of status=UNKNOWN. PRD-v3 why-codes per docs/DECISIONS.md D-U1; D-7 cause families map in as basis_missing→UNKNOWN_EVIDENCE, identity_fuzzy→UNKNOWN_POPULATION, no_basis_anywhere→UNKNOWN_TESTABILITY

severity.description: Independent of status: a passing critical control still tells the consumer the stakes

support.description: FAIL and UNKNOWN verdicts must carry support; PASS may be terse

collected_at.description: RFC 3339; the pattern enforces the shape because format alone is annotation-only in most validators

record_hash.description: SHA-256 of the evidence record at intake (D-1)

chain_prev.description: Hash-chain link to the previous record; null only for the first record in a chain

completeness_ref.description: Pointer to the completeness assertion for the population this verdict is scoped to

spec_hash.description: Hash of the frozen collection spec that produced the record: run_id says when, spec_hash says under what ratified plan

test_function_version.description: Version of the pure function that emitted the verdict, with its seeded-fixture reference

ratification_ref.description: Pointer to the hashed human sign-off; required when status=EXCLUDED (D-V1)

disposition_ref.description: Pointer to the dispositioned-exception record (REI: justification + owner + review date); required when status=EXCEPTION

evidence_refs.description: Typed pointers to backing artifacts — pointers, never payloads
